title.narrative: Sustainable industrial production in the cassava and other agro-food sectors through the use of renewable energy applications and low-carbon technologies

description.narrative: Côte d#Ivoire is deemed to have significant potential for use of renewable energy in its industries, including the food industry........ The project therefore aims to study the agro-food priority sectors and explore potentials for the installation of renewable energy applications in the production chain. Feasibility studies will be elaborated in collaboration with private sector partners in order to assess the economic viability of a biomass power station at a given site to support the production chain of agro-food products. Following the site identification, a power station will be constructed and management model put in place which will ensure the feasible operation of the site by a private operator.
